items.title: Introducing Kaleidoscope BirdNET
items.reported: An integrated acoustic identification and review workflow.
items.wildlitics_action: A useful future audio-review pattern: retain recording, alternatives and reviewer decisions. Check component licences and local species performance before an optional audio module.

items.title: WILDLABS AWARDS 2026: AudioMoth Edge
items.reported: A project developing hardware and software for on-device sound recognition.
items.wildlitics_action: Track constrained-device requirements, but do not treat planned hardware as a completed camera-trap identification upgrade.

items.title: Introducing DroneMegaDetector
items.evidence_type: Preprint and author announcement; under review as stated in post
items.reported: A drone-image detector with tiled inference, code and weights; a preprint is linked.
items.wildlitics_action: Consider only for future aerial imagery. Benchmark camera-trap and aerial domains separately; do not substitute it for the terrestrial baseline.

items.title: TwigaTools: an open intelligence hub
items.reported: No-code summaries and connectors layered over existing monitoring platforms, with connectivity and permissions considered.
items.wildlitics_action: Use modular imports/exports and reproducible summaries; retain platform permissions and offline caches if connectors are added.

items.title: Speeding-up AI training
items.reported: Timelapse, MegaDetector and SAM2 help prepare YOLO training data. A comment dated 12 October points to Annotator-Pro.
items.wildlitics_action: Extend assisted annotation after checking licences, preserve per-object labels and keep manual review and site grouping. The single-class-per-image assumption needs explicit rejection for mixed scenes.

items.title: Automating wildlife monitoring with .NET, FFmpeg and MegaDetector
items.reported: A live-camera intake and frame-sampling workflow with author-reported runtime improvements.
items.wildlitics_action: Use timestamped local video intake, recoverable jobs and sampling-recall evaluation. No local speed claim can be transferred from this post.

items.title: Wildlens
items.evidence_type: Personal-project report without independently assessed benchmark
items.reported: The author reports a livestream species detector trained with iNaturalist imagery.
items.wildlitics_action: Use as an example of an intake/demo flow; verify training-image domain, split design, class coverage and code availability before considering the model.

items.title: Machine Learning for Camera Trap Footage
items.reported: Contributors distinguish blank filtering, species identification and individual re-identification, and emphasise review ergonomics.
items.wildlitics_action: Measure reviewer time and correction burden, and make individual-ID a separately validated task.

items.title: SpeciesNet Studio: self-hosted review UI
items.reported: A contributor presents a self-hosted SpeciesNet review interface.
items.wildlitics_action: Inspect review organisation and alternative-candidate presentation as product references; check code licence before reuse.

items.title: SpeciesNet Bugs on Addax AI Windows
items.reported: The thread discusses NumPy/PyTorch compatibility and a Windows process issue; the exact root cause was not established.
items.wildlitics_action: Add Windows installation/inference/cancellation checks and pinned environment diagnostics. Do not prescribe a blanket NumPy downgrade from this anecdote.

technical_references.title: CameraSweet official tools
technical_references.use: Reference for clock corrections, camera groups, occupancy matrices and independent-picture counts; no application code was copied.

technical_references.title: MegaDetector official documentation
technical_references.use: Check model variants, inference options, supported domains and version-specific licensing. Wildlitics already documents MDV6.

technical_references.title: SpeciesNet official repository
technical_references.use: Check package/model identities, preprocessing, format migration and classifier-only reuse of saved detections.

technical_references.title: Camtrap DP standard
technical_references.use: Pin a schema version and validate deployment, media and observation exports.

technical_references.title: camtrapR CRAN package
technical_references.use: Check current version and local R integration; code and analytical defaults require explicit version tracking.

technical_references.title: Annotator-Pro
technical_references.type: Author repository; linked from WILDLABS comment
technical_references.use: Annotation UI and assistance reference. Assess actual licence and dependencies before reuse.

technical_references.title: BioCLIP: A Vision Foundation Model for the Tree of Life
technical_references.type: CVPR 2024 conference paper and official implementation; not counted in journal quota
technical_references.use: A biological representation baseline; biological photos and camera-trap images have different distributions.

technical_references.title: BioCLIP 2: Emergent Properties from Scaling Hierarchical Contrastive Learning
technical_references.type: NeurIPS 2025 conference paper; not counted in journal quota
technical_references.use: Supports the existing BioCLIP 2 feature option. Benchmark local identification and retrieval separately.

technical_references.title: DINOv2 official implementation
technical_references.type: Official model documentation; outside the DOI-verified journal quota
technical_references.use: Candidate encoder for a local classifier/retrieval comparison; its inclusion does not establish a local accuracy gain.

technical_references.title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
technical_references.type: ICML 2017 conference paper; not counted in journal quota
technical_references.use: Foundation for post-hoc calibration, complemented here by a camera-trap-specific calibration paper.

technical_references.title: Estimating species overlap: author resources
technical_references.use: Reference implementation and interpretation for circular temporal overlap and uncertainty.
